title: Plant Companion
description: An intelligent plant care assistant leveraging AI to diagnose plant diseases, offer tailored care tips, and manage watering schedules seamlessly.
challenges: Integrating Agentic AI features for accurate real-time plant disease detection and diagnosis.
Optimizing complex state management across multi-step user onboarding and plant care schedules.
Ensuring seamless JWT session security and fast image upload processing for field photos.
improvements: Add automated push notifications and email alerts for plant watering and sunlight reminders.
Implement community sharing forums for plant enthusiasts to exchange tips and photos.
Introduce offline-first PWA caching for diagnosing plants in gardens without active internet connection.

title: DigiMart
description: A modern e-commerce marketplace platform for digital products featuring seamless cart management, user authentication, and seller dashboards.
challenges: Handling real-time inventory counts and instant digital file delivery upon purchase.
Designing responsive product filtering with category trees and pricing sliders without lag.
Ensuring secure client-server authentication and role-based access for buyers and sellers.
improvements: Integrate multi-currency payment gateways (Stripe, SSLCommerz, PayPal).
Add automated license key generation and instant download management.
Implement user review and rating verification system.

title: Prompt World
description: An interactive marketplace and sharing platform for AI prompts with secure authentication, prompt testing preview, and Stripe payment integration.
challenges: Configuring webhooks with Stripe for asynchronous payment confirmation and prompt unlock.
Building a syntax-highlighted prompt preview engine for Midjourney, ChatGPT, and Claude prompts.
Managing complex search indexing across prompt categories, tags, and AI model compatibility.
improvements: Add direct API execution playground to test prompts in real-time before buying.
Introduce author subscriptions and creator monetization analytics dashboard.
Add prompt versioning and bookmarking collections.

title: Pet Is Family
description: A compassionate pet adoption platform connecting rescue pets with adopters, featuring breed insights and foster application workflows.
challenges: Designing intuitive multi-step adoption application forms with validation.
Managing dynamic image galleries for pet profiles across varying screen dimensions.
Implementing efficient MongoDB aggregation queries for filtering pets by age, breed, and location.
improvements: Add live chat between potential adopters and shelters.
Integrate vet appointment scheduling and vaccination records tracking.
Introduce a pet donation and shelter sponsorship portal.

title: Tile Canvas
description: A creative canvas application for interactive tile-based web designs, pattern generation, and visual layout experimentation.
challenges: Achieving 60fps animations during dynamic drag-and-drop tile reordering.
Optimizing GSAP timeline triggers for smooth scroll-driven canvas transitions.
Ensuring cross-browser canvas rendering accuracy across desktop and mobile browsers.
improvements: Add SVG export and high-resolution PNG rendering of custom tile patterns.
Implement collaborative real-time editing using WebSockets.
Expand library of pre-built tile templates and procedural pattern generators.

title: KeenKeeper
description: A smart productivity task and note management application designed to help users organize priorities, deadlines, and project notes.
challenges: Implementing instant local state updates with asynchronous cloud database syncing.
Structuring flexible tag-based note categorization and rich text formatting.
Ensuring clean user interface responsiveness on narrow smartphone displays.
improvements: Add markdown support and code snippet syntax highlighting for tech notes.
Implement recurring task schedules and reminder notifications.
Introduce task board views (Kanban, List, Calendar).

title: Dragon News
description: A dynamic news portal featuring categorized news feeds, trending story carousels, and responsive article readers.
challenges: Optimizing dynamic routing and fast server-side rendering for category feeds.
Building clean layout structures for media-dense news articles.
Managing social share integrations and bookmarking states.
improvements: Add personalized news feed based on user reading history.
Implement dark mode and adjustable reading font sizes for articles.
Integrate audio TTS (Text-to-Speech) for listening to news articles on the go.
